## Code Review Summary
Mode: specification; pass: repair. Candidate `config-admission-resilience-spec-r17` (sha256 `c193033c…` matches the state's `sha256` field). Inputs: spec, tickets 01–04, `review-cr-r16.txt`, `plan.json`, `execution-state.json`, cited source anchors (re-read here).

**CT16 C9 (r17 delta) — substantively closed.** T2 `blockedBy` is `["T1","T3"]` in `plan.json` and in the canonical T2 entry; §6/§9/§10 state T1→T3→T2→T4; T2's post-T3 capture prerequisite and its AC10 gate are coherent.

**Prior ledger `review-cr-r16.txt` — 0/5 closed** (all LOW; re-verified against r17 text):
- [LOW][stale-citation] decision id: `spec.md:195,522` say `approve-complete-secret-inventory-authorization`; the artifact says `"decision":"authorize-complete-secret-inventory"` (`owner-secret-inventory-authorization.json`).
- [LOW][stale-citation] `Config.resolved` anchors: `internal/config/config.go:67` (field) and `:456` (assignment), not `:68`/`:455`; wrong at `spec.md:177,197,216,255,311,411,441,493,499,514`.
- [LOW][ac-not-falsifiable] AC1 (`spec.md:385`) observable includes the admission class, but its `-run` pattern omits `TestStartupAdmissionFailureClass`; `go test -run` exits 0 when absent (AC5 `:388` runs it, so coverage is only partial).
- [LOW][statement-contradiction] AD4 (`spec.md:293`) makes `MCP_STRICT_CONFIG=1` strict; R4 (`:208`) says non-true keeps R3; AC13 (`:397`) tests only "false"/"yes"/"0" — no oracle for `1`.
- [LOW][statement-contradiction] `spec.md:406` still says "the only `internal/config` change is the widening-3 resolver pair"; R8 (`:216`) and §10 name `ResolvedSecrets()` too.

**New findings**
- [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] `spec.md:309` (AD20), `:204` (R2), `:401` (AC17) and §4.5 require the pre-fix capture on the **post-T3 build** and cite AD20 as its authority, while the artifact's recorded scope is "running the **T1 build** against the live instance's actual config/state" (`owner-ticket02-evidence.json`). r17 introduced this mismatch (pre-r17 the capture was on the T1 build, matching the artifact). Fix: record a fresh owner decision naming the post-T3 build, or capture on a T1-only build and stop attributing the post-T3 run to AD20.
- [LOW][ledger-state-drift] `issues/02-…:8` still says "Blocked by: 01"; canonical T2 `blockedBy` is `["T1","T3"]`. §6 T2 names the T3 edge but, unlike ticket 03, records no ticket supersession. Fix: coordinator records it in ticket 02.
- [LOW][stale-citation] `spec.md:187` (C9 row) claims the order changed "everywhere it is stated … and the historical J1/K2 currency notes"; `spec.md:11` and `:19` still state T1→T2→T3→T4. Fix: annotate both as superseded.
- [LOW][ac-not-falsifiable] R7 (`:214`) forbids secrets in `config_loaded`; AC8 (`:392`) names negative oracles only for the copy and `config_degraded` (`TestLastKnownGoodCopyHasNoSecrets`, `TestConfigDegradedEventHasNoSecrets`); no fixture covers `config_loaded` (exposure bounded — both fields are paths).

**Verified sound (independently re-read)**
Tickets 01–04 all map to R→AC (01→AC1–5, 02→AC17–19, 03→AC6–11, 04→AC12–16); every AC has a runnable command or named evidence lane (AC17 inspection, AC18 owner lane). Anchors hold: `serve.go:108,136,139,143,145-154,282-315,317-324,339,389,397,406,409,414-420`; `loop.go:103,105,110,117-118,122,137,139,157-160,162-163,168,180,195,206-212`; `startup_failure.go:11,62,71,108-115,130`; `envelope.go:41-56,587,705,721` (only `cause` moves the pin; `stage` is already a union member); `config.go:81,97-104,381,384,433,576-592` (`single()` sets `not_checked`, so AC9 parity is achievable); `bounds.go:167-186` (`embedding.timeout: 3s` valid); `legacyStageVocabulary` has no bare `admission`; pin 130 at `config_envelope_test.go:166-170`. Envelope/effects match: state `writePaths` carry the two exact `internal/config` files (`:138-139`), T3 effects the same pair (`:296-297`), `allowedEffects` read/write/test (`:146`). Exactly-one and scan-skip semantics are oracled (AC14/AC8), and every exit path in `serve` has a named class.

Limits: read-only; no tests, `effectCheck` or spec-lint executed; prior findings checked against text only.

### Recommendation
APPROVE
</output>
</task-result>
